versions.changelog: 1.0.4: No relay needed; refresh task; user access note. 1.0.3: Relay asks stations like an audio player. 1.0.2: Plugin image, Favorites folder, localized folder names, music album layout option, more reliable stream URLs.

name: Internet Radio
description: Adds an Internet Radio entry next to Live TV. Stations come from the free, community-maintained radio-browser.info directory and can be browsed by country, genre and language.
overview: Browse and play internet radio stations
